fixed.change: The oauth branch of resolvePrincipal now LEFT JOINs api_keys, returns keyId, and accepts a token only if its key_id is the current root generation or an existing, unrevoked, unexpired key. Rows with key_id NULL are rejected. Root principals carry keyId 'root:'+16 hex of sha256('brainmcp-root-generation:'+BRAIN_TOKEN), stored in the existing key_id column (no schema change), so app.js and oauth.js stamp it automatically and rotating BRAIN_TOKEN kills all root-derived credentials.

fixed.change: The same join enforces the parent key's expiry on every session and OAuth token lookup. The code and refresh grants re-check the parent via a new parentKey() and issue tokens with the key's current role and scopes. Access and refresh exp are min(offset, key.expires), and expires_in is capped to match. Principals now expose `expires` (the parent key's expiry).

Expect forced re-authentication on deploy. Every existing session and OAuth token with key_id NULL stops resolving: all root-derived ones and any laundered ones. claude.ai connectors must reconnect, and any client registered without redirect_uris must re-register.

Audit legacy scoped admin keys: SELECT id, name, prefixes FROM api_keys WHERE role = 'admin' AND prefixes NOT IN ('[]', ''). Change each to write or make it unscoped. They keep admin powers on app.js and index.js routes until groups B and C land isRootAdmin.
Optional cleanup: DELETE FROM oauth_tokens WHERE key_id IS NULL; DELETE FROM oauth_clients WHERE redirect_uris IN ('[]', '') OR redirect_uris IS NULL;
notes: Shared interface is in src/auth.js as specified: safeRepoPath, boundary-aware allowed, isRootAdmin, and isProjectSlug, which now requires a first character in [a-z0-9] (taken literally, so slugs starting with an uppercase letter are rejected too). Also new: rootKeyId(env), parentKey(env, keyId), and principal.keyId/principal.expires on every principal.

For group C: app.js:135 still writes a fixed +30-day session exp. The join already enforces key expiry, but the row's exp can be capped with min(datetime('now','+30 days'), coalesce(?, ...)) bound to principal.expires. Nothing in app.js needs to change for key_id: principal.keyId is now always set, root sessions included.

For group B: getFile now throws on non-canonical paths, so indexFromGitHub (index.js:19) throws if a webhook delivers such a path. Git cannot produce '..' segments, but a file name containing a backslash or control character would abort that push's indexing.
